prompts.Base: Precise asset extraction/edit of supplied reference sheet for FUTIN football player card. Output ONE transparent-background PNG, portrait, high resolution. Extract/reconstruct ONLY the far-left 'BASE DE LA CARTA' card frame, extremely faithful to its exact silhouette and material: straight vertical side rails, two broad smoothly curved upper scallops meeting in a small central upturned crown point, bronze/copper multi-line bevel border, angular bronze corner ornaments as in source, bottom curved shield sides meeting at centered downward point. Dark charcoal almost black flat interior, understated original diagonal bronze reflection. Front facing perfectly flat and symmetric, NO perspective, NO new ornament, NO circle/badge/crest/player/text/statistics. Preserve the reference bronze pale metallic border, not a gold variant. Card occupies nearly all portrait canvas with modest clear transparent margins, entire lower tip visible. Add only one subtle thin straight horizontal bronze separator across the INNER dark area at 70 percent of card height, dividing future portrait/name area above from statistics area below. No large rectangle around stats. Exterior true alpha transparency including upper concave scallops and below curved point; interior remains opaque dark charcoal. Do not include any other items from the source sheet, source captions, black background or checkerboard. Output asset named bronze-base.png if paths supported.

prompts.Name: Precise extraction/edit of ONLY the 'BANNER DE NOMBRE' strip at right middle of supplied reference. One isolated wide horizontal nameplate PNG asset on transparent alpha background. prompts.Effect: Extract and recreate ONLY the lower-right 'OVERLAY DE EFECTOS' from supplied card reference as a high resolution transparent PNG overlay for bronze SPECIAL cards.
